mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat into intestinal cells, packaging it and sending it into lymph made its different route concrete. The explanation that lymph later carries the particles to blood helped connect the steps.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the villus after the fat goal was complete gave no useful next step. It was a reasonable check, but the empty result left the blood route uncertain.

surprise.text: I expected fat entry and packaging to happen together, but entry came first. Packaging then required another interaction with the villus.

arbitrary.text: Using the villus for packaging and lacteal entry makes sense as a location, but directly pairing the named materials seemed plausible too. The compatibility feedback resolved both attempts.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it continues to connect these routes to what cells do. The contrasting blood and lymph routes gave the constructions a clear purpose, though the final blood-route combination was less obvious.
